name: Strong Paws Rescue Community Pet Pantry
notes: Free dog and cat food, collars, harnesses, leashes and basic supplies at pantry events in the Bronx and Westchester. It no longer makes monthly deliveries: it holds pantry events two to four times a year. Fill in the form on its pantry page to be told about the next one, or email request@strongpawsrescue.org.
